summary: iter-40 Phase 3 Batch A (Payment Voucher + Overdue Alerts) — backend + frontend fully verified. Backend: 10/10 pytest passing — (1) auto voucher on final payment approval populates payment.voucher_id/voucher_no (PV-26-NNNN)/voucher_path/voucher_generated_at + inserts payment_vouchers row with amount/vendor/qrn/center_id/company_id/generated_by; (2) GET /voucher/download returns application/pdf w/ %PDF- header + %%EOF footer; (3) non-paid → 400; (4) LAZY-GEN: after stripping voucher_* fields + deleting payment_vouchers row, GET /voucher/download regenerates PDF and backfills payment doc; (5) POST /voucher/email returns 200 with {ok:true, emailed, voucher_no, to} and writes emailed_to_vendor_at/emailed_to/emailed_by to payment_vouchers (Resend is best-effort — not configured in this env, but endpoint OK); (6) non-paid email → 400; (7) GET /payment-vouchers exposes X-Total-Count; (8) q search on voucher_no works; (9) overdue flow: released advance with future required_till NOT overdue; after backdating to 2025-01-01 the row appears in /overdue with is_overdue=true + days_overdue>0, GET /advance-requests/{id} + /advance-requests/my both enrich; POST /overdue/notify returns {total_overdue, notified, skipped_no_email}; (10) pre-existing bug FIXED — GET /api/transactions now returns 200 (posted→approved migration + release_advance status fix). Frontend: Advances page shows overdue-banner (with '1 advance overdue for settlement' text + red border), overdue-chip-<id> (1), overdue-filter-toggle (toggling filters rows 20→1), overdue-notify-btn (POST returns 200), row-level adv-overdue-<id> badge (1). Quotations page shows green 'Voucher' button (voucher-download-<pid>) + email icon (voucher-email-<pid>) on paid rows (8 paid payments each have both); voucher-email-modal opens with to_email/cc/subject/custom-message fields and 'Send Voucher' button.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:4788-4801 — voucher auto-gen is correctly wrapped in try/except with logger.exception; a failing voucher will NOT block payment finalisation (best-effort as intended). Good.

server.py:9683-9713 — /voucher/download lazy-generation path correctly backfills payment.voucher_id/voucher_no/voucher_path/voucher_generated_at when a legacy paid payment lacks a voucher. Verified via test.
server.py:9243-9261 — _annotate_overdue sets is_overdue/days_overdue based on status ∈ {released, adjusting} + required_till < today. Correct.

server.py:9382-9442 — /overdue/notify is idempotent and best-effort on email (silently swallows Resend errors). Consider surfacing the per-user email delivery result in the response for better observability, but non-blocking.

server.py:9429-9436 — inline resend send here is duplicated with email_utils.send_email_with_attachment; could refactor to a shared _send_html helper for consistency (currently the overdue notify path uses raw resend.Emails.send directly instead of the shared util). Non-blocker.

server.py:9744 — POST /voucher/email is role-gated to admin/accountant/hr/senior_manager (matches spec); manager role NOT included, whereas GET /payment-vouchers listing includes manager. Intentional? Ok as-is since download endpoint has broader access.
server.py:9799-9805 — /payment-vouchers X-Total-Count exposed via Access-Control-Expose-Headers — correct for cross-origin frontend consumption.
Frontend Advances.jsx overdue banner uses red-50/border-red-600 — good contrast. AdvanceTable row highlight uses adv-overdue-<id> badge inline in Required Till cell — clear visual cue.

Frontend Quotations.jsx voucher-email-modal reuses shadcn Dialog; default subject 'Payment Voucher PV-26-0003 — TEST_Vendor_...' is pre-filled from voucher metadata — nice UX. voucher-download link is a plain <a href={backend}/voucher/download> which the browser handles as a file download (works but the response wasn't captured by page.wait_for_event; the backend pytest already asserts PDF integrity so this is fine).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Batch-A testids present + happy flows verified — banner/chip/toggle/notify/voucher-download/email-modal)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_iter40_Co/IT40-<run> company+center, several TEST_iter40 quotations (~5) + payments (2 paid to end state, others left pending for negative tests), 1 fresh released advance backdated to 2025-01-01 for overdue-flow then restored to 2026-12-31 in teardown. All prefixed TEST_iter40 for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch A of Phase 3 (Payment Voucher + Overdue Alerts) is fully functional end-to-end. Voucher stored primarily via _put_object; local fallback /tmp/payment_vouchers/ also covered. Overdue endpoint filters status ∈ {released,adjusting} + required_till < today. To reproduce overdue UI in future testing: pick any released advance and UPDATE db.advance_requests.required_till to a past ISO date, then reload /advances. Pre-existing iter-38 bug (transactions listing 500) is now RESOLVED — GET /api/transactions returns 200. Advance-request enrichment (is_overdue/days_overdue) is applied on list, my-list, and single-GET.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs surfaced this iteration. Every requested feature (voucher auto-gen, download, lazy-gen, email, list w/ search+X-Total-Count, overdue list+notify+enrichment, transactions 200 fix) passed.
